title: Fall of Nineveh
summary: A Median–Babylonian coalition captures the Assyrian capital and ends the neo-Assyrian empire.
body: Assyria had dominated the Near East for generations. The sack of Nineveh redistributed power toward Babylon and the Medes. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Van de Mieroop, A History of the Ancient Near East
